source_method: gh PUBLIC verification then cp -a tracker to disposable directory; certified SDK includeBody reads; no extensions

selection.split: sha256(seed,repository,terminal_canonical_id) first hex digit below 8 is dev; controls require both sides in same split
selection.control_policy: top lexical pairs outside resolvable duplicate groups; identical semantic projections excluded; all other non-edges are closed-world controls, not independently adjudicated negatives
selection.label_audit: One identical-text control was replaced by the next lexical candidate independently of model probabilities. Original observations retained in excluded; 107 calls per model arm: 105 scored pairs, one excluded identical-text control, and one replacement inference repeated after a postprocessing assertion aborted before persisting it. The latter attempt is counted but its probability and latency were not retained. Final replacement observations are persisted before validation.
selection.threshold_fit_note: Initial exploration imposed an empirical 95% precision filter and selected no 0.8b cutoff. Final objective is dev F1 with unchanged 0.8 floor and minimum three positive predictions. Held-out labels did not determine cutoffs. The 4b numeric cutoff was frozen in a separate dev-only receipt before 4b held-out inference. A zero-true-positive support guard was added during dev inspection and does not change either measured cutoff.
selection.source_limit: Only 29 available trackers passed visibility and complete-copy reads; 35 resolvable duplicate closures, including 31 explicit consolidation receipts. Larger label estimates were not reproduced.

ci_method: Precision, recall and abstain: two-sided 95% Wilson. F1: monotone harmonic envelope from Bonferroni 97.5% Wilson bounds for precision and recall, an approximate conservative envelope, not a binomial F1 interval. Correlated pairs are not independent samples.
wall_scope: elapsed from initial inference receipt timestamp through final publication, including postprocessing and repeated replacement calls
